findings.conclusion: Source proves the callback call occurs after RestrictedIgnoreTrainer finite checks and before super().save_model(); DetectionTrainer does not override save_model, so that super resolves to BaseTrainer whose FP16 conversion acts on deepcopy(EMA). Runtime execution of this actual MRO remains the root smoke's responsibility.

FP32LiveCaptureMixin must be first in MRO and must not be combined with fp32_capture_callback. Its test uses a substitute Base.save_model, so the component test alone is not a real DetectionTrainer lifecycle proof.

Constructor/callback require original main thread; nonblocking hook lock prevents hook reentry. Before/after tensor hashes and EMA update count detect supported mutations. Deepcopy forwards protect live state and head caches. These checks do not exclude arbitrary external concurrent writers, which caller protocol must forbid.

All floating source tensors must already be finite FP32, CPU, AMP args/effective false, enabled eval EMA with completed updates. The hook performs no half-to-float recovery. Dtype checks cannot independently detect a caller's earlier FP16-to-FP32 lift; fresh no-checkpoint training provenance belongs to the bound root protocol.

Only a tensor state payload is loaded via frozen FORMAT weights_only=True. Architecture comes from a canonical allowed-key/module cfg dictionary, not an external YAML/model pickle. Fresh DetectionModel strict load requires no missing/unexpected keys; state shape/dtype/value hashes and analytic-input output structure/dtype/value hashes must match the frozen live copy. Rebuilding inference-only does not rebuild the custom training criterion or optimizer/resume state.

A selected epoch writes into a new .pending directory and commits via same-parent rename only after source identity, exact state, reconstruction, and unchanged live state/update checks; existing epoch outputs cannot be overwritten.

All 15 direct component members, external source pins and both nested manifests match. Saved architecture and state metadata bind consistently; 23/23 tests are reported by an honest terminal-summary receipt. Full raw unittest transcript was not retained and this review does not claim independent test rerun or independent tensor deserialization/forward.

required_root_checks: bind current Dataset/Trainer/capture/format source bytes in the training contract before run
fresh random architecture and generated synthetic-only inputs; prohibit checkpoint/model weight reads
execute actual one-epoch CPU DetectionTrainer optimizer/EMA lifecycle with workers=0 and AMP=false
observe capture completion before framework half serialization via actual training events
independently audit captured new state/architecture/output and preserved live FP32 EMA
